gloss: to step into; to raid; to delve into

definitions.gloss: to step into; to set foot in
definitions.explanation: To physically enter a space by stepping inside, often with determination or force.
To forcibly enter a location, typically used in the context of police raids or investigations.

definitions.gloss: to delve into; to go deeply into
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to explore a topic, issue, or territory more deeply than before.

examples.japanese: {未知|みち}の{領域|りょういき}に{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む{勇気|ゆうき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need the courage to step into unknown territory.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}が{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}の{家|いえ}に{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The police raided the suspect's house.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}についてもう{少|すこ}し{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}んで{議論|ぎろん}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's delve a little deeper into this issue.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む → {踏|ふ}み{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む → {踏|ふ}み{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む → {踏|ふ}み{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {踏|ふ}む (to step on) + {込|こ}む (into)

The ～{込|こ}む pattern indicates entering into or going deeply into something.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{家宅|かたく}に{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む - to raid a house
・プライバシーに{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む - to intrude on someone's privacy
・{核心|かくしん}に{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む - to get to the heart of the matter
・{一歩|いっぽ}{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む - to take a step further
